description: Route mo otel query through the Server query surface, add --json field selection, surface truncation, and remove the local SQLite bypass.

tasks.title: Add columns to Server QueryResult response
tasks.description: Add a `columns` field (string array) to the Server-side `QueryResult` record and populate it in `TraceQuerier.ExecuteBoundedQuery` across all return paths (normal, row-limit truncation, byte-limit truncation). The field names are already collected from the reader before the read loop; this wires them into the response so consumers can render headers for empty or byte-truncated results. Update the Server spec tests to assert `columns` is present and carries the correct field names.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /otel/api/query` response `data` includes a `columns` array matching the SELECT field names
A result with 0 rows still carries the correct `columns` array
Row-limit and byte-limit truncated results carry the correct `columns` array
Existing `OtelQueryRoutesIntegrationSpecs` pass with the added `columns` assertions
`dotnet build packages/server` succeeds with no warnings
tasks.output: Updated QueryResult record and TraceQuerier.ExecuteBoundedQuery in packages/server; updated OtelQueryRoutesIntegrationSpecs with columns assertions
tasks.notes: Design Decision 1. The fieldNames are already collected at TraceQuerier.cs:166-170; only the record and return statements change.

tasks.title: Route mo otel query through Server and add --json field selection
tasks.description: Rewrite `OtelCommands.BuildQuery` / `RunQueryAsync` to POST `{ sql }` to `/otel/api/query` via `api.SendAsync`, read the response through `ExtractEnvelope`, and render columns/rows from the Server result. Add a `--json` option wired through `JsonSelectionOption` with a static descriptor (`columns`, `rows`, `truncated`, `truncate_reason`). Surface truncation with a notice line naming the reason. On Server error, surface the envelope error/code to stderr. On HttpRequestException, surface the standard ServerUnavailableMessage. Remove the `--db` option, `SqliteOtelQueryExecutor`, `IOtelQueryExecutor`, `OtelQueryResult`, `OtelQueryException`, `ResolveDatabasePath`, and all local-path resolution. Simplify `OtelCommands.Build` to drop the `environment` and `queryExecutor` parameters, and remove the `queryExecutor` parameter from `MohistCliCommands.RunAsync` and the DI resolution at the call site. Rewrite all CLI query tests to use `RecordingHttpHandler` fakes and delete `FakeOtelQueryExecutor`.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo otel query "SELECT 1"` sends POST /otel/api/query and renders the Server result
`mo otel query --db foo` is rejected as an unknown option with non-zero exit
`mo otel query --json` lists fields [columns, rows, truncated, truncate_reason] without contacting Server
`mo otel query "SELECT ..." --json rows,truncated` emits only the selected fields as JSON
Truncated results render a notice with the truncate_reason
Server unreachable produces the standard ServerUnavailableMessage on stderr with non-zero exit
Server query errors surface the error message and code to stderr with non-zero exit
No `SqliteOtelQueryExecutor`, `IOtelQueryExecutor`, `--db`, or `ResolveDatabasePath` reference remains in packages/cli
`npm run typecheck` and `dotnet build packages/cli` succeed with no warnings
tasks.output: Rewritten MohistCliCommands.Otel.cs, updated MohistCliCommands.cs call site, rewritten CliOtelCommandSpecs.cs, deleted FakeOtelQueryExecutor.cs
tasks.notes: Design Decisions 2-6. T-001 must land first so the CLI can consume the columns field. The environment parameter is removed from OtelCommands.Build because it was only used for database path resolution.

tasks.title: Update CLI reference docs to close the otel query implementation gap
tasks.description: Remove the implementation-gap note in `docs/cli-reference.md` that records `otel query` as reading local storage and only outputting tables. The documented command contract (query through Server, --json field selection) now matches the implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/cli-reference.md no longer lists otel query as reading local storage in the implementation-gap section
The otel query command shape in the cheat-sheet reflects Server-routed execution with --json support
tasks.notes: docs/cli-reference.md currently has the gap at the 'otel query' bullet in the implementation-gap section (~line 401).
